---
title: "EMDE Homepage"
---

Welcome to the EMDE project website. Each cell below shows the explanatory power (R²) of the currency-basket regression within one estimated exchange-rate regime. Use the sidebar to open a country page, or see [About](about.qmd) for the methodology and references.

```{r landing}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(dplyr, ggplot2, scales, plotly, knitr)
source("R/plots.R")
S <- readRDS("results/summary.rds")
plot_timeline(S$regimes, S$order, S$events, "XKDRORGFILES/XKDR_Logomark_RGB_Full_Colour.png")
```
